bartel2019_TableS1.csv es una copia sin modificar (byte a byte) de TableS1.csv del repositorio
https://github.com/CJBartel/perovskite-stability (commit 965b8de5b379dde09a6cb1f223ae0f0b9d3ce54e),
de Bartel et al. (2019), Sci. Adv. 5, eaav0693.

  sha256 bea471ddb1ed63dcb94cc9cbc58c73f3bc1a12918e96cf24818b3aea2cbe3656
